COSMIC SURVIVORS – Every Decision Keeps the Crew Alive

COSMIC SURVIVORS is an interactive educational survival simulation game designed to help students understand the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth. Players choose between Moon and Mars missions, customize astronaut crews, and manage five essential survival systems: power, life support, food, radiation shielding, and crew health.

Through resource-management mini-games, unexpected mission events, and critical decision-making scenarios, players experience a 30-day survival mission where every choice affects the crew's ability to survive. The game connects gameplay with real-world space research concepts, including NASA's work in environmental control and life support, space radiation, space power systems, space crop research, and astronaut health.

By combining interactive gameplay with science-based explanations, COSMIC SURVIVORS makes space exploration, resource conservation, and space engineering more engaging and accessible to students.
details:
Project Description

COSMIC SURVIVORS is an interactive space-survival simulation that demonstrates the challenges of maintaining human life in extraterrestrial environments. The project focuses on the resource limitations and engineering decisions involved in establishing sustainable human settlements on the Moon and Mars.

Players begin by selecting a mission destination and customizing their astronaut crew. Throughout the 30-day mission, they must manage five interconnected survival systems: power generation, life support, food production, radiation shielding, and crew health.

The gameplay follows a daily survival cycle involving resource-based mini-games, resource allocation, daily consumption, unexpected mission events, and critical decision-making. Each decision influences the availability of resources and the crew's survival progress. Science explanations help players understand the real-world engineering principles behind each challenge.

The project is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with an interactive mission dashboard, resource management system, event engine, and scoring system.

COSMIC SURVIVORS aims to transform complex space science concepts into an engaging learning experience while encouraging scientific curiosity, logical thinking, resource conservation, and problem-solving skills.
